definitions.gloss: rough skin; skin irritation; chapped skin
definitions.explanation: condition where the skin becomes rough, dry, or irritated due to weather, stress, diet, or other factors

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肌荒|はだあ}れしやすい。
examples.english: Skin gets rough easily in winter.

examples.japanese: {肌荒|はだあ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I apply moisturizing cream to prevent rough skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{肌荒|はだあ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My skin irritation got worse from stress.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (skin) + {荒|あ}れ (roughness). Describes skin that has become rough, dry, red, or irritated.

COMMON CAUSES:
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧: dryness (especially in winter)
- ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧: stress
- ⟦{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}→睡眠不足：08690_suiminbusoku⟧: lack of sleep
- ⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れ→乱れ：11413_midare⟧: poor diet
- ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧: pollen (seasonal allergies)

FORMS:

- {肌荒|はだあ}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have rough skin (suru-verb)
